fields.title: Executive call with Harbor Point’s new operations director
fields.cause: The champion who ran the rollout left on Oct 21; nobody owns Tidewater there now and two depots have gone idle. Renewal is Dec 20.
fields.plan: Our VP of Customer Success and Maya meet Dan Moreno with a usage report per depot and a 30-day re-launch plan; agree on a new internal owner.

fields.title: Re-train the Bayonne and Newark depots
fields.cause: 37 of 120 seats have not logged in for 30 days, all at the two depots the old champion trained herself.
fields.plan: Two on-site sessions and a driver quick-start card; product analytics agent reports depot logins daily for two weeks.

fields.title: Escalate the route-sync bug behind Cedar & Pine’s three urgent tickets
fields.cause: The same sync failure every Monday has pushed two sites back to paper; tickets have waited up to 11 days.
fields.plan: Engineering lead joins Monday’s sync window live; Leo calls Rachel Ortiz with the fix date and a credit for October.

fields.title: Call Brightline’s owner about the unpaid September invoice
fields.cause: The invoice is 52 days late and the owner is unhappy about the missed QuickBooks sync — the two are likely connected.
fields.plan: Call Tom Becker with the sync fix date, offer to split the invoice in two, and confirm a payment date.

fields.title: Renewal review with Summit Dental before December
fields.cause: Renews Dec 31 on watch: usage down while two clinics renovate, and an urgent double-booking ticket is open.
fields.plan: Close the double-booking ticket, show per-clinic reporting, and offer to pause the renovating clinics’ seats until January.

fields.title: Onboard Meridian’s nine new Denver seats
fields.cause: Expansion, not risk: new branch opening Oct 20.
fields.plan: Two remote training sessions; all nine seats active by Oct 30.
